property_summary: For any caller Q and any target address U, after funding U and Q appropriately, c.getBalance(U) returns the stored balance of U (i.e., userBalance[U]); the mutant that returns userBalance[msg.sender] will break this when Q != U and balances differ.
change_summary: Replace return of userBalance[u] with return of userBalance[msg.sender], so getBalance returns the caller's balance regardless of the provided address.
